gloss: to offer; to propose; to volunteer

definitions.gloss: to offer; to propose; to volunteer; to apply
definitions.explanation: To formally put forward an offer, proposal, or request. Slightly formal in register.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}が{手伝|てつだ}いを{申|もう}し{出|で}た。
{退職|たいしょく}を{申|もう}し{出|で}る{社員|しゃいん}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of employees applying to resign is increasing.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}か{問題|もんだい}があれば、{遠慮|えんりょ}なく{申|もう}し{出|で}てください。
examples.english: If there are any problems, please don't hesitate to speak up.

notes:
{申|もう}し{出|で}る is a compound verb meaning to formally offer or propose something. It has a slightly formal tone.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: Xを{申|もう}し{出|で}る

ASPECT (ている):
- {申|もう}し{出|で}ている means "has offered / has made a request" (resulting state)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {協力|きょうりょく}を{申|もう}し{出|で}る: to offer cooperation
- {退職|たいしょく}を{申|もう}し{出|で}る: to submit a resignation

The noun form is {申|もう}し{出|で} (an offer; a proposal).
